snippet.title: Spellsword Cards: Demontide Trailer
snippet.description:
Spellsword Cards: Demontide is a solo offline PvE card combat RPG with multi classing and epic boss fights. Deckbuilding, story, strategy and crafting combine to make an experience that's hard to put it down once you start.

Additional modes of play include: Roguelike Deckbuilder, Drafting and One Turn Puzzles.

PC Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/801210
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.oneupplus.spellswordcards.demontide
itch.io: https://oneupplus.itch.io/spellsword-cards-demontide

Coming soon to iOS and Mac Store
